today_in_history_posts.title: Full Disclosure: CVE-2023-40231 / CVE-2023-40232 / CVE-2023-40233 / CVE-2023-40234 "All your mempool are belong to us"
today_in_history_posts.summary: - The author highlights concerns about replacement cycling and various other significant lightning security risks.  - They advocate for conservative information sharing during disclosures to limit exploitation and protect users.  - Plans include ongoing public discussion, answering inquiries, and a possible demonstration of an attack later in 2024.

today_in_history_posts.summary: - Security risks in Lightning, such as replacement cycling, require base-layer fixes and careful information disclosure.  - The author urges improved security practices, highlights misunderstood vulnerabilities, and explains distorted resignation reports.  - Plans include public engagement, possible mainnet attack demonstration, and optimism for Lightning's robust future.

today_in_history_posts.title: Thoughts on scaling and consensus changes (2023)
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Bitcoin scaling relies on 50,000 off-chain entities like federated sidechains, Chaumian ecash banks, and coinpools.  - Large-scale transactions require interconnected, semi-trusted off-chain services, effective auditing, and efficient exit tools.  - Solutions must balance scalability, decentralization, and security while supporting regulatory compliance and operational safety.
